blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) has reported that 28 of 119 pumps in 29 pumping stations being operated by the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) were “unserviceable” mostly because of delays in repair and rehabilitation.
